hero.title: AI + Motion Control
hero.description: Industrial motion-control solutions built on PLCs and host-PC applications, supporting mainstream PLC brands (Mitsubishi, Siemens, Omron, Keyence, Inovance) and motion control cards (Leadshine, Googol, Advantech, ADLINK, Zmotion). We deliver C#/C++ host-PC software development, widely applied in automation equipment for the display, new-energy, and medical industries.
